'''Neysa Ayellin''' is a resident of the [[Two Rivers]]. 

== Appearance ==
She is horse-faced with gray hair which is in a braid.{{ref/book|4|42}}

A conflicting passage describes her as "Almost as pretty as Egwene" {{ref/book|2|36}}

== Activities ==
She spanked Perrin when he was ten for stealing a pie.{{ref/book|4|42}}

As part of the [[Women's Circle]], she presides over the wedding of [[Perrin]] and [[Faile]].{{ref/book|4|53}}

She helps defend [[Emond's Field]] against the invading [[Trolloc]] army. She helps [[Bode Cauthon]] and [[Eldrin Cauthon]] kill a Trolloc using a butchering knife.{{ref/book|4|56}}
